modules.title: Inspect native geometry identity
modules.instruction: Map synthetic source volume, CAD object ID, mesh representation and explicit unit frame.
modules.qualification_hold: Unit conversion and native CAD source authenticity remain unverified

modules.title: Prove geometry transformation loss
modules.instruction: Generate a synthetic cube triangle mesh and compare with a parametric box constraint model.
modules.expected_artifact: R0 original and transformation loss map
modules.qualification_hold: Triangle geometry is not proof of original parametric intent

modules.title: Compose five container digital fixture
modules.instruction: Reuse the CGX five-unit synthetic facility layout, reserving circulation, service and future expansion volumes.
modules.expected_artifact: collision matrix, held logistics BOM and unallocated volume
modules.qualification_hold: No shipping, structural or site qualification

modules.title: Separate taxon, occurrence and game representation
modules.instruction: Create distinct records for a birch taxon, actual specimen and a game-tree asset.
modules.expected_artifact: typed representation links; no false Object_ID merge

modules.title: Verify geodetic frames
modules.instruction: Project small synthetic site polygons between declared coordinate reference systems.
modules.qualification_hold: Actual map basemap rights and accuracy separately assessed

modules.title: Derive habitat intervention review
modules.instruction: Overlay a synthetic M1 corridor geometry with clearly labelled mock species observations.
modules.expected_artifact: evidence-linked impact matrix and unknowns ledger
modules.qualification_hold: No environmental approval or biodiversity assertion

modules.title: Compare software and scientific authority
modules.instruction: Distinguish a spacecraft runtime, telemetry view, orbit propagator and mission approval authority.
modules.qualification_hold: A public simulator is not a flight-qualified mission system

modules.title: Attach epoch and frame to ephemeris
modules.instruction: Use a fabricated sample position table with explicit time scale, coordinate frame and units.
modules.expected_artifact: frame-aware parsed sample and validation gates
modules.qualification_hold: No current real JPL ephemeris fetched or verified

modules.title: Qualify a computational fluid or FEM result
modules.instruction: Trace a synthetic solver output from mesh/settings to numerical error and physical assumptions.
modules.qualification_hold: No physical flight, fluid, structural or thermal certification

modules.title: Separate engine from game asset
modules.instruction: Represent an engine candidate and two rights-distinct game asset packages.
modules.expected_artifact: engine package key, per-game manifest and licence review
modules.qualification_hold: Index CC0 is not licence for game art or binaries

modules.title: Deduplicate shared dependency references
modules.instruction: Model two synthetic cartridges with one exact engine SHA-256 and distinct source roots.
modules.expected_artifact: single cached dependency and cold/warm byte accounting
modules.qualification_hold: ABI and runtime compatibility must still be established

modules.title: Evaluate replay and portability
modules.instruction: Define deterministic input/output playback for a hypothetical compatible game pair.
modules.qualification_hold: Do not claim successful playback without executable rights and tests

modules.title: Understand typed numeric and tabular data
modules.instruction: Apply a small synthetic conversion across scalar, vector and table records with units.
modules.qualification_hold: Numerical type equivalence is not semantic identity

modules.title: Identify model/runtime dependency boundaries
modules.instruction: Record model architecture, weights, tokenizer, serving runtime and licence as separate objects.
modules.expected_artifact: model package dependency and ACL matrix
modules.qualification_hold: Never infer rights to model weights from a Python library licence

modules.title: Evaluate a claim with independent fixtures
modules.instruction: Run a designed test suite comparing synthetic model claims with controlled reference outputs.
modules.qualification_hold: No autonomous canonical promotion or unseen real-world validity

modules.title: Inspect upstream software licence boundaries
modules.instruction: Compare an SPDX licence declaration with actual missing game asset and dataset rights.
modules.expected_artifact: SPDX expression, dependency and distribution decision hold
modules.qualification_hold: External repository metadata is not full redistribution clearance

modules.title: Separate archive capture from playable preservation
modules.instruction: Catalogue synthetic historical web snapshots and runtime candidate without embedding media.
modules.expected_artifact: archive time/source list, survivability and reproduction unknowns
modules.qualification_hold: Wayback captures do not automatically license games or expose binaries

modules.title: Build a source-cited offline kit candidate
modules.instruction: Create an OCI-like source descriptor and RO-Crate-inspired metadata over permitted synthetic documents.
modules.expected_artifact: portable index, exact SHA-256, attribution and offline reopen receipt
modules.qualification_hold: No claim of formal standard conformance or live public rights acceptance

invariants: Use only synthetic fixtures or independently rights-cleared sources until licence and site gates pass.
All exercises preserve distinct source, semantic object, representation, adapter, execution and evidence identities.
A lesson does not qualify hardware, trained ML model, mission software, engine ABI or published content.
Do not connect public offline kit to private credentials, user accounts or unverified source media.
Require owner review, measured conformance and DBR before any claimed operational or physical acceptance.
